sentence: Genotypes GC + CC of rs1800462 are not associated with increased risk of myelotoxicity, liver toxicity, or need for 6-mercaptopurine dose reduction/interruption in people with pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia receiving BFM ALLIC 2009 maintenance therapy in Colombia as compared to genotype GG (p > 0.05).
explanation: An observational longitudinal study genotyped TPMT rs1800462 by TaqMan and used chi-square tests; no significant associations with 6-mercaptopurine toxicity or dose modifications were observed during 6 months of follow-up (p > 0.05).
